settings.heading: Home care made with plants you already know.
settings.text: Neem, tulsi, aloe vera, reetha and citrus have been part of Indian homes for generations. We put them into everyday handwash, dishwash and floor cleaner, and name every ingredient on the bottle.
settings.image_alt: A line-up of Amrit Herbals bottles beside neem leaves and a lemon half

settings.heading: It started with reading the back of a bottle.
settings.text: Our founder started Amrit Herbals to make a handwash for the family where every ingredient was a plant they recognised.
settings.text_2: The first product was a neem and tulsi handwash, made in small batches and shared with friends and neighbours before it reached our first customers.

settings.title: Every ingredient on the label
settings.text: Each product leads with its hero plant and lists everything else that goes in, in plain words.

settings.title: Only claims we can back
settings.text: We say "made with natural ingredients" and show you which ones. No vague promises.

settings.title: Less plastic with refills
settings.text: Refill packs fit the bottles you already have, so one bottle can keep going.

settings.title: Pick the plant
settings.text: Each product starts with one hero ingredient: neem for hands, lemon for dishes, lemongrass for floors.

settings.title: Build the formula
settings.text: We develop each formula around its hero ingredient, then try it at home before it goes further.

settings.title: Check every batch
settings.text: We check each batch before it is bottled, so every bottle matches the one before it.

settings.title: Fill, ship, refill
settings.text: Bottled, labelled and delivered across India, with refill packs for when you run out.

settings.heading: What we say, and what we won't.
settings.text: Cleaning products are full of big words. We keep ours to what we can show you.
Made with natural ingredients
Every ingredient named on the label
Certifications listed here once confirmed
"Chemical-free". Everything, water included, is a chemical.
"100% natural", unless the formula really is.
Health claims we have not tested.
